bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'CREATOR_WORKTREE_AND_RUNTIME_MAPPING\n'
printf 'WORKTREES\n'; git worktree list --porcelain | grep -E '^(worktree |HEAD |branch |detached)' | head -65 || true
printf 'MAIN_PROJECT_BRANCHES\n'; git branch --list --format='%(refname:short)|%(objectname:short)' | head -20 || true
printf 'DEPLOY_HOME_CONTENTS\n'; find "$HOME/.local/share/gace-create-videobot" -maxdepth 3 -type f \( -name 'Dockerfile' -o -name 'compose.videobot.poll.yaml' -o -name '.env.example' \) -print 2>/dev/null | head -30 || true
printf 'DEPLOYED_IMAGE_METADATA\n'; docker image inspect sha256:79ee66291b1e52ae71460cde30e752b5cd356d97ff2cf2fd307797b99b823cd4 --format 'created={{.Created}} size={{.Size}} tags={{json .RepoTags}}'
printf 'POLL_CONTAINER_COMMAND\n'; docker inspect gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1 --format 'image={{.Config.Image}} entrypoint={{json .Config.Entrypoint}} command={{json .Config.Cmd}} restart={{.HostConfig.RestartPolicy.Name}}'
printf 'LOCAL_API_IMAGE_PRESENT\n'; docker image ls --format '{{.Repository}}:{{.Tag}}' | grep -Ei 'telegram-bot-api' || true
printf 'FFMPEG_HOST='; command -v ffmpeg || true
printf 'SECURE_CREDENTIAL_KEYS_PRESENT_ONLY\n'; for v in TELEGRAM_API_ID TELEGRAM_API_HASH VIDEOBOT_LOCAL_API_ID VIDEOBOT_LOCAL_API_HASH; do if [ -n "${!v:-}" ]; then printf '%s=yes\n' "$v"; else printf '%s=no_env\n' "$v"; fi; done
printf 'POLL_ENV_TERMS_PRESENT='; docker inspect gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1 --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' | cut -d= -f1 | grep -Fx CREATEVDOBOT_TERMS_URL >/dev/null && echo yes || echo no
